context: User requested diagnosis and repair of repeated fixed-production release failures.

missedSlot.rootCause: A successful semantic prepublish gate had no automatic handoff to the writer. A separate last-minute external trigger-file write was a single point of failure; the 18:00 request never reached the canonical trigger. This incident did not reach Pages deployment.
missedSlot.permissionQualification: An audit-only interactive main write succeeded at commit 7c2354d420c4e368b7b3fb274ca7c932ed059703, followed by the authorized atomic code repair. This does not establish that a past scheduled tool denial was absent; it does disprove a current universal repository write outage.

originalAutomation.title: Gallery 08/18正式发布
originalAutomation.routingChange: Read docs/fixed-slot-release-handoff.md and reuse an already armed/running/released same-slot writer. Do not duplicate the trigger, create competing locks, cancel valid work, or disable the original task after an individual failure. Existing push-trigger fallback remains available only when there is no valid writer and the fixed slot is still legally executable.

codeRepair.handoff: Successful same-repository main push prepublish gate -> existing writer workflow_run -> existing Pages workflow_run in main context -> existing verified delivery finalizer.
codeRepair.preSlotBehavior: Read-only wait within 65 minutes, repeatedly refresh current main and check approved authority inputs; no production admission before the named 08:00/18:00 slot.
codeRepair.atSlotBehavior: Rerun existing --allow-deferred --require-ready validators and strict conversion, then recheck current main and real time immediately before one non-force atomic release commit.
codeRepair.gateEvidence: Both actual require-ready results, matching generation/DOI partitions, exact pretty-JSON UTF-8 formal/pending Git blob hashes, scope references and per-article scopeAssessment are required.
guards: no-op writer must not claim prior marker deployment

prepublish.bundleComparison: Relative to the original gate bundle, only formal/pending generatedAt and their consequent serialization hashes changed. Original handoffGeneratedAt, approved input SHAs, scope evidence and all decisions remained unchanged. Neither bundle was admitted off-slot.

automaticWriter.qualification: Actual automatic handoff and expired-slot rejection were verified. A successful no-op is not a new literature release. The artifact also contains the unchanged old execution result; it must not be attributed to this no-op run.

pagesRedeployment.redirectQualification: The receipt records the GitHub Pages entry redirecting to gallery.gczhouwld.com. These are two tested entry points, not two independently hosted origin copies.
pagesRedeployment.qualification: Successful real deployment of the already-authorized unchanged 726-card snapshot. This is not the missed 18:00 release.

acceptanceBoundary: Missing automatic handoff, strict artifact transfer, negative timing guard and main-context redeployment have actual-run proof. The next slot still needs its own fresh audit/staging and actual production commit/deployment/live validation. No guarantee is inferred from configuration or a successful no-op.
